entities.name: Charles Jacques Édouard Morren
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charles Jacques Édouard Morren was a Belgian botanist, professor of botany and director of the Jardin botanique de l'Université de Liège from 1857 to 1886. His special field of study was the Bromeliaceae on which family he was the recognized authority. He was the son of Charles François Antoine Morren.
